verdict.rationale: Docs claim cross-platform compatibility for web, mobile and desktop, and say Babylon Native runs scenes natively outside the browser. That covers the desktop and mobile parts of the story from a single codebase. Nothing in the pack mentions console export, either directly or through partners. One community report calls it a strictly web-based engine poorly suited to standalone games, which weakens confidence in the native path but does not concretely disprove it. Missing for 10: console export (direct or via partners), documentation of the actual desktop/mobile packaging and export workflow, independent hands-on corroboration of native deployment.
